_comments: UsageTypeID is the base measure a billing unit is a quantity of; UnitsPerBillingUnit is how
many of that measure make ONE billed unit, so cost = (quantity / UnitsPerBillingUnit) *
PricePerUnit. Both columns are added (nullable) by the AIPromptRun_Continuous_Units
migration and populated here rather than by an UPDATE in that migration, so the values are
The four token/image rows below the first two shipped in the v3 baseline and were never
tracked as metadata; they are declared here with their baseline IDs and text so the push
updates the existing rows rather than creating duplicates.

fields.Name: Per Minute
fields.Description: Time-based pricing billed per minute of session/audio time — the unit realtime voice and speech models (e.g. GPT-Realtime-Translate, GPT-Realtime-Whisper, conversational-agent platforms) publish their rates in. Cost rows using this unit express the price per ONE minute; consumers multiply by elapsed minutes (fractional minutes pro-rate).

fields.Name: Per Hour
fields.Description: Time-based pricing billed per hour — for hourly-billed model capacity (e.g. dedicated/provisioned realtime endpoints). Cost rows using this unit express the price per ONE hour; consumers pro-rate fractional hours.

fields.Name: Per 1M Tokens
fields.Description: Pricing calculated per million tokens processed. This is the standard unit for most modern LLMs including OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude, and Google models.

fields.Name: Per 1K Tokens
fields.Description: Pricing calculated per thousand tokens processed. Common for older models and some specialized providers.

fields.Name: Per 100K Tokens
fields.Description: Pricing calculated per hundred thousand tokens processed. Used by some providers as an intermediate pricing tier.
